description: The repository provides R code and inputs for a spatial policy study of green-hydrogen diffusion. It combines pipeline proximity, potential offtakers and technology cost trajectories in an empirical and simulation analysis. The provider is Rumpelnik, Zakeri and Surana. Coverage: The study covers Europe, includes a database described as more than 14,000 potential offtakers and cost trajectories through 2050. Detailed sampling and spatial resolution require the paper. Access: The public README documents inputs and execution requirements. No data files or code were downloaded. Licence and cost: The repository shows MIT. SciGRID and other upstream data retain their own terms and attribution requirements. Limitations: Offtaker aggregation, runtime and testing claims were not independently checked. The README’s printed Zenodo identifier was not adopted without confirmation. For simulation it supports reproduction of demand-side policy and spatial diffusion scenarios. Related resources: The README explicitly uses SciGRID pipeline-segment geodata, covered by data-scigrid-gas.
